cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Who Changed It?
cards.instruction: Ask innocent questions until someone admits altering the plan, schedule, arrangement, or shared space.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Interesting. The picnic moved from Saturday to Friday. Whose blue pen is that?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. And whose handwriting adds hearts to Fridays?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Now, who should tell the Saturday guests?

mechanism: A uses careful evidence-order corrections and apparently innocent scheduling questions to make B admit changing the picnic date.
confusable: An accusation announces guilt; D40 requires questions that progressively establish who changed the shared arrangement.
comparison: Room alternative questions linked furniture and storage changes; picnic alternative identifies the author of a calendar alteration and its notifications.
seedUse: Blue pen, hearts and changed Friday derive from D40-a; S03 adds precise author-versus-tool and change-versus-notice distinctions.
